name: icloud-mail
description: Let Claude read, search, organize, draft and send your iCloud Mail, with guardrails. Works alongside Apple Mail.
long_description:
Connects Claude directly to your iCloud Mail account (imap.mail.me.com and smtp.mail.me.com) with an Apple **app-specific password**. It runs locally on your Mac and works alongside Apple Mail: everything Claude changes (read, flagged, moved, archived, trashed, drafts, sent mail) syncs to Apple Mail through iCloud. Works with @icloud.com, @me.com and @mac.com addresses and with iCloud+ custom domains.

**What Claude can do**
- Search mail and read messages, conversation threads and attachments
- Mark messages read or unread, flag them (Apple Mail colours), move, archive and trash them
- Create, rename and delete (empty) folders
- Save drafts that appear in Apple Mail's Drafts folder, and send them once you approve
- Send new mail, replies and forwards

**Guardrails**
- *Sending* can be switched off entirely (drafts keep working). Sending, replying and forwarding are marked as destructive actions, so Claude Desktop normally asks for your approval before each one; how often it asks depends on your Claude Desktop version and your answers to its prompts. For a check Claude cannot skip, turn on the Mac confirmation dialog.
- *Permanent deletion* is off by default; deleting moves mail to Trash, which you can restore from until Trash is emptied (normally after about 30 days).
- *Read-only mode* lets Claude only read and search: nothing in your mailbox can change.
- Optional *native Mac confirmation dialog*: every send and permanent delete also needs a click on a macOS dialog that Claude cannot press for you. It lists every recipient.
- At most 30 sends, 150 recipients per hour and 500 recipients per day (adjustable), and 50 recipients per message. Mail can only be sent from your own iCloud addresses.
- Files can be attached only from the folders you choose (Desktop, Documents and Downloads by default); Claude can read files in those folders. Downloaded attachments are saved only into your attachment folder and are marked as downloaded from the internet.
- Email content is handed to Claude marked as untrusted data, and Claude is told never to follow instructions found in emails. This lowers the risk of "prompt injection" but cannot rule it out, so keep reviewing send approvals, or turn on the Mac confirmation dialog.
- Every change is recorded in an audit log (~/Library/Logs/icloud-mail-mcp/audit.jsonl), without message bodies.

**Privacy**: your app-specific password is stored in the macOS Keychain by Claude Desktop and is only sent to Apple's mail servers. The extension runs on your Mac and has no servers of its own; the emails, search results and attachment contents Claude reads become part of your conversation and are processed by Anthropic like anything else you share with Claude.

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List your mail folders with total and unread counts

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search one folder or all folders by sender, recipient, subject, text, date, flags or size

tools.name: get_message
tools.description: Read one email: headers, attachment list and text body

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Find every message in the conversation an email belongs to

tools.name: get_account_info
tools.description: Show the connection settings, enabled features and today's date; explains setup problems

tools.name: download_attachment
tools.description: Save an attachment to your attachment folder (small images and text are shown to Claude)

tools.name: mark_messages
tools.description: Mark messages read or unread, flag or unflag them, or set an Apple Mail flag colour

tools.name: trash_messages
tools.description: Move messages to Trash (recoverable until Trash is emptied, normally about 30 days)

tools.name: rename_mailbox
tools.description: Rename or move a folder you created

tools.name: delete_mailbox
tools.description: Delete an empty folder you created

tools.name: save_draft
tools.description: Save a draft (new, reply or forward) to your Drafts folder without sending it

tools.name: send_email
tools.description: Send a new email (only when you ask; marked destructive, so Claude Desktop asks first)

tools.name: reply_to_message
tools.description: Reply or reply-all to an email (only when you ask; marked destructive, so Claude Desktop asks first)

tools.name: forward_message
tools.description: Forward an email with its attachments (only when you ask; marked destructive, so Claude Desktop asks first)

tools.name: send_draft
tools.description: Send a draft from your Drafts folder as saved (only when you ask; marked destructive, so Claude Desktop asks first)

tools.name: delete_messages_permanently
tools.description: Permanently delete messages, bypassing Trash (off unless you allow it; cannot be undone)

prompts.name: triage_inbox
prompts.description: Summarise unread iCloud mail from the last N days, grouped by importance, and suggest actions without taking them.
prompts.text: Please triage my iCloud Mail inbox: summarise the unread mail from the last ${arguments.days} days (default 7). Use only read-only tools, group the messages by importance, and suggest next steps without taking any of them until I confirm.

prompts.name: summarize_thread
prompts.description: Summarise an email conversation: participants, decisions, open questions and action items. Describe it (sender or subject), or give a mailbox and message UID.
prompts.text: Please summarise the email conversation ${arguments.about} (or the one containing message uid ${arguments.uid} in mailbox ${arguments.mailbox}) in my iCloud Mail, using read-only tools only: find it with search_messages if needed, then use get_thread.

icloud_email.title: iCloud email address
icloud_email.description: Your primary iCloud Mail address, e.g. name@icloud.com (iCloud Mail must be turned on). It is used to log in. This is not the email you sign in to your Apple Account with if that is a Gmail, Outlook or other address. If you use an iCloud+ custom domain, enter your @icloud.com address here and your custom-domain address under From address.

app_specific_password.title: App-specific password
app_specific_password.description: Create one at account.apple.com > Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords (two-factor authentication is required). Your regular Apple Account password will not work. Stored in the macOS Keychain.

imap_username.title: IMAP login (optional)
imap_username.description: Leave blank to log in with your iCloud email address (for @icloud.com, @me.com and @mac.com addresses the part before the @ is tried automatically if that fails). Set this only if your login is different; a full address entered here is also used to log in for sending.

from_address.title: From address (optional)
from_address.description: The address your mail is sent from, e.g. your custom-domain address or an iCloud alias. It must be an address of your iCloud account. Leave blank to send from your iCloud email address.

from_name.title: Your name (optional)
from_name.description: Display name shown to recipients, e.g. Jane Appleseed.

allowed_from.title: Other From addresses (optional)
allowed_from.description: Comma-separated extra addresses Claude may send from (aliases of your iCloud account). Your iCloud email and From address are always allowed; anything else is refused before sending.

allow_send.title: Allow sending
allow_send.description: Let Claude send, reply to and forward email, and send saved drafts. Claude Desktop normally asks for your approval before each send; turn on "Confirm on my Mac" for a check Claude cannot skip. Turn off to allow drafts only; you can then send drafts yourself from Apple Mail.

allow_permanent_delete.title: Allow permanent delete
allow_permanent_delete.description: Let Claude permanently delete messages, bypassing Trash. This cannot be undone. When off, Claude can still move mail to Trash.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Only allow reading and searching: no marking, moving, deleting, drafts or sending. Overrides the two settings above.

confirm_dialog.title: Confirm on my Mac before sending or permanently deleting
confirm_dialog.description: Every send and permanent delete also shows a native macOS dialog listing every recipient, which you must click (Send or Delete) yourself. Claude cannot bypass it. If you do not answer within 2 minutes, nothing happens. Moving mail to Trash and deleting empty folders are not confirmed.

attachment_dir.title: Attachment download folder
attachment_dir.description: Where attachments that Claude downloads are saved. Created if it does not exist. Existing files are never overwritten.

attach_from_dirs.title: Attach files from
attach_from_dirs.description: Folders Claude may attach files from when sending or drafting mail; Claude can also read files in these folders (even when sending is off). Files anywhere else are refused. If you remove every folder, Desktop, Documents and Downloads are used again; to stop Claude attaching local files, choose one empty folder.

max_body_chars.title: Maximum email length shown to Claude
max_body_chars.description: Email bodies longer than this are cut to this many characters (1,000 to 100,000). This is a hard maximum: Claude cannot ask for more.

max_sends_per_hour.title: Maximum emails sent per hour
max_sends_per_hour.description: Safety limit across sends, replies and forwards. 0 means no limit.

max_recipients_per_hour.title: Maximum recipients per hour
max_recipients_per_hour.description: Total To, Cc and Bcc recipients across all sends in any hour. 0 means no limit. iCloud itself allows about 1,000 recipients a day and may suspend sending beyond that.

max_recipients_per_day.title: Maximum recipients per day
max_recipients_per_day.description: Total recipients across all sends in any 24 hours. 0 means no limit. Keep it below iCloud's limit of about 1,000.

sent_mailbox.title: Sent folder (optional)
sent_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use iCloud's own "Sent Messages" folder. Set this only if the wrong folder is used, e.g. because another mail app created a similarly named folder.

trash_mailbox.title: Trash folder (optional)
trash_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use iCloud's own "Deleted Messages" folder. Set this only if the wrong folder is used, e.g. because another mail app created a similarly named folder.

drafts_mailbox.title: Drafts folder (optional)
drafts_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use iCloud's own "Drafts" folder. Set this only if the wrong folder is used, e.g. because another mail app created a similarly named folder.

archive_mailbox.title: Archive folder (optional)
archive_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use iCloud's own "Archive" folder. Set this only if the wrong folder is used, e.g. because another mail app created a similarly named folder.

junk_mailbox.title: Junk folder (optional)
junk_mailbox.description: Leave blank to use iCloud's own "Junk" folder. Set this only if the wrong folder is used, e.g. because another mail app created a similarly named folder.
